name: stage-track
title: Stage Track
description: Where a piece of work is in a configurable pipeline (branch, PR, dev, prod): StageTrack shows every stage in a row, reached ones filled and the current one emphasised, or only the current one as a StagePill. StageFilter is a toggle group with a count per stage.
docs: Stages are { id, label, tone? } with the shared Tone vocabulary; a stage without a tone uses the primary colour, and StagePill defaults to info. `current` is a stage id; stages before it count as reached. The track is an ordered list with `aria-current="step"` on the current stage, and each state has its own marker shape (check, ring, hollow), so meaning never rests on colour; give it an `aria-label`. Below a 24rem container it stacks into a column. `getHref(stage)` makes a stage a link. StageFilter is a UI SDK ToggleGroup (several stages by default, `multiple={false}` for one): nothing pressed means no filter, which a segmented control can't express. Agents set it with `setValue` and stage ids.
